description: WEEKNUM stale return_type: a reader (A3) refers to a marker (A1) with another cell (A2) between them in the order. If the precedent is calculated on demand, the order is A1, A3, A2 and A2 reads A3's Sunday; if A3 is moved to after A1 and re-run, the order is A2, A1, A3 and A2 reads nothing. Readers decode the reused start weekday: WEEKNUM(2..7,99) joined gives 111111 Sun, 222222 Mon, 122222 Tue, 112222 Wed, 111222 Thu, 111122 Fri, 111112 Sat; markers WEEKNUM(100,t) with t 1 Sun, 2 Mon, 12 Tue, 13 Wed, 14 Thu (T-1484)
